name: Prolifen
description: Prolifen is a broad-spectrum tissue regeneration accelerant that combines targeted growth factor cocktails with cellular energy substrate supplements to dramatically increase the rate of wound healing and surgical recovery. It is particularly formulated for the mixed organic-synthetic tissue environments common in augmented individuals, where standard regeneration can be complicated by chrome adjacency and SNT integration zones.
effects: promotes quality tissue regrowth rather than scar formation
side_effects: intense localized heat and itching at regeneration sites
fatigue as metabolic resources are redirected
risk of keloid overgrowth in genetically predisposed individuals
can accelerate growth of undiagnosed neoplasms
duration: Active regeneration boost 12-18 hours per dose; treatment course varies
cultural_context: Prolifen is a staple of every clinic from the Shelf to the Spire, though quality varies enormously. Tier 4-5 clients get pharmaceutical-grade Lazarus formula with precise dosing; Shelf clinics use diluted stock or unlicensed generics that work approximately. Street surgeons who do black-market augment installs keep Prolifen on hand — it's what keeps botched jobs from becoming fatal. Fighters and laborers use it off-label to recover faster from injuries.
story_hooks: A patient treated with Prolifen after surgery is healing too fast — their tissue is growing into their augments, and something in the compound is driving the process beyond normal limits
A Shelf trauma surgeon is rationing diluted Prolifen across a mass casualty event and has to choose who heals
Counterfeit Prolifen on the black market contains a dormant marker compound — anyone who's used it can be tracked by Lazarus security teams
